description: コミュニティバス・乗合タクシーGTFS-JP情報 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 延岡市. 延岡市のコミュニティバス及び乗合タクシーのバス停、時刻表、ルート等の情報を網羅したGTFS-JP形式のデータ(静的情報)です。. Coverage: 延岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 延岡市. Its tags are GTFS-JP, インフラ, マップ情報, 交通とインフラ, 共通フォーマット. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
